data.gender_notes: Mustarshid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is given the guidance and shown the way. In Islamic context, refers to Allah (SWT) as the ultimate guide. The name Mustarshid carries the meaning “Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mustarshid usually hope their child will grow to embody guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mustarshid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustarshid total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Mustarshid also holds immense spiritual significance, as it refers to Allah (SWT) as the ultimate guide for all mankind. The believer's constant endeavor is to seek Allah's guidance and to follow His commands in every situation. Mustarshid brings to light the trust and faith we have in Allah (SWT) to guide us towards the right path and help us make correct decisions. In essence, the name Mustarshid represents the belief in the power and wisdom of Allah (SWT) to guide us towards success and happiness in this world and the hereafter.
